blocks.text: Bunyadi zarre (fundamental particle) se muraad aisa zarra hai jis ki koi andaruni banawat na ho, yaani jo taqseem na ho sake. Is waqt maadde ke bunyadi ajza quarks (protons, neutrons aur mesons quarks se bane hain) aur leptons (electrons, positrons aur neutrinos samet) mane jate hain. Inhein maadde ki bunyadi eentein mana jata hai.

Jab nucleus ko intehai zyada energy wale particle accelerator mein toda jaye, ya do zyada energy ke zarre takrayein, to bilkul naye qism ke zarre bante hain jo bazahir aam maadde ke atoms mein maujood nahi. Yeh maadde ki bunyadi banawat parakhne ke liye zaroori shadeed takraon ka nateeja hain. Sau se zyada naye zarre pehchane gaye aur milti julti khusoosiyat wale khandanon mein taqseem kiye gaye. In mein se bohat se nazariyati physicists ke nizam mein fit aaye, jabke baqi 'strange particles' kehlaye. Yeh hamesha joron mein bante hain; maslan jab pion (pi-) proton se takrata hai to do strange zarre K0 aur Lambda0 bante hain: pi- + p -> K0 + Lambda0.

Tamam zarre apne mehwar par ghoomte (spin) hain, aur charged zarron ka spin unhein nanhe magnets banata hai. Electrons, protons aur neutrons ka spin 1/2, photon ka 1 aur pions ka sifar hai. Aadhe spin wale zarre Pauli ke exclusion principle par chalte hain, jo kehta hai ke ek qism ka sirf ek zarra kisi quantum halat mein ho sakta hai; inhein fermions kehte hain. Sifar ya poore adad spin wale zarre is usool par nahi chalte; inhein bosons kehte hain, kyunke yeh Bose-Einstein statistics par chalte hain. Mazeed bari taqseem yeh hai:

items: Nucleons aur un se bhaari zarre jaise Lambda0 aur K0 jo nucleons mein decay hote hain, baryons (bhaari) kehlate hain. (K0 asal mein meson hai; print ise yahan likhta hai.)
Muons nucleons se strong taamul nahi karte aur electron, tau aur neutrinos ke saath leptons (chhote) kehlate hain.

blocks.text: Beta decay ki dono qismein (beta-minus aur beta-plus) saboot hain ke protons aur neutrons bunyadi zarre nahi. 1960s tak neutron aur proton jaise bohat se naye zarre aur bohat se 'darmiyane' zarre, mesons, daryaft ho chuke the jin ke masses zyada tar nucleons se kam magar electron se zyada the (baad ke kuch mesons nucleons se bhaari hain). Taqatwar taamul wale pi mesons, ya pions, kehlaye, jabke kamzor taamul wale mu mesons, ya muons (muons ab leptons mane jate hain). Is se yeh nateeja nikla ke yeh zarre bunyadi nahi ho sakte aur aur bhi chhote ajza se bane hon ge, jinhein quarks ka naam diya gaya.

Zarron ko un par lagne wali chaar bunyadi forces ki bunyad par bhi taqseem kiya ja sakta hai. Gravity tamam zarron par asar karti hai magar subatomic satah par is ka asar itna kam hai ke aam taur par nazar-andaz kiya jata hai; electromagnetic force, jo tamam charged zarron par lagti hai, achi tarah samjhi gayi hai aur zaroorat par li ja sakti hai. Zarron ko is bunyad par taqseem kiya ja sakta hai ke woh strong force se taamul karte hain ya nahi: jo strong force mehsoos karein woh hadrons, aur jo na karein woh leptons hain. Hadrons ki misalein protons, neutrons aur pions, jabke electrons aur neutrinos leptons hain.

Hadrons murakkab (composite) subatomic zarre hain jo do bari qismon mein bant-te hain: kuch bosons hain, mesons kehlate hain, jaise pion, aur kuch fermions, baryons kehlate hain, jin ki aham misalein protons aur neutrons hain. Baryons quarks ki taaq tadaad (aam taur par teen) se, aur mesons juft tadaad (aam taur par do: ek quark aur ek antiquark) se bante hain. Leptons sirf weak ya electromagnetic taamulat se taamul karte hain. Koi tajruba abhi tak leptons ki andaruni banawat nahi dikha saka; yeh waqai bunyadi zarre lagte hain jo toote nahi ja sakte. Tamam maloom leptons ka spin 1/2 hai, to sab fermions hain. Chhe maloom leptons teen joron mein hain (Table 12.3); har jore mein ek charged zarra (e-, mu-, tau-), us ka neutrino, aur mutabiq antiparticles hain. Charged leptons doosre zarron se mil kar atoms aur positronium jaise murakkab zarre banate hain, jabke neutrinos shaz-o-nadir kisi cheez se taamul karte hain aur is liye kam dekhe jate hain. Sab se mashhoor lepton electron hai.

blocks.alt: Oopar baen: zarron ko hadrons aur leptons mein, aur hadrons ko teen quarks wale baryons aur quark-antiquark wale mesons mein bant-ta darakht. Oopar daen: chhe quarks un ke charges aur masses ke saath, proton do up aur ek down quark aur neutron ek up aur do down quarks ki shakal mein. Neeche baen: force carriers, Higgs boson aur kaainat ke notes. Neeche daen: Standard Model, quarks, leptons, force carriers aur Higgs boson ke taur par.

blocks.long_description: Jo zarre strong force mehsoos karte hain woh hadrons hain, jo ya to teen quarks ke baryons hain, jaise proton aur neutron, ya quark aur antiquark ke mesons, jaise pions; jo nahi karte woh leptons hain, electron, muon aur tau aur un ke neutrinos, jin ki koi andaruni banawat nazar nahi aati. Chhe quarks maloom hain, up, down, charm, strange, top aur bottom, jin ke charges do tihai musbat ya ek tihai manfi hain: do up aur ek down proton ko ek musbat charge dete hain, aur ek up aur do down neutron ko neutral chhorte hain. Forces bosons le jate hain, photons, gluons aur W aur Z, aur Higgs boson batata hai ke zarre mass kaise pate hain. Yeh sab mil kar Standard Model banate hain, jo abhi tak gravity, dark matter ya dark energy ki wazahat nahi karta.

blocks.prompt: Fermions aur bosons mein farq bataiye (short question 12.6). Meson boson hai ya fermion; wajah dijiye (constructed response 12.2). Misalon ke saath hadrons aur leptons mein farq bataiye (short question 12.12).
blocks.explanation: Fermions ka spin aadha adad (1/2) hai, Pauli ke exclusion principle par chalte hain aur electrons, protons, neutrons aur quarks shamil hain; bosons ka spin sifar ya poora adad hai, Bose-Einstein statistics par chalte hain aur photons, gluons, pions aur Higgs boson shamil hain. Meson quark aur antiquark se bana hai, do spin-1/2 zarre jin ke spins mil kar poora adad (0 ya 1) dete hain, to woh boson hai. Hadrons strong force mehsoos karte aur quarks se bane hain (protons, neutrons, pions); leptons strong force mehsoos nahi karte aur un ki koi maloom andaruni banawat nahi (electrons, muons, neutrinos).

items: Bunyadi zarra: koi andaruni banawat nahi; quarks aur leptons. Zyada energy ke takrao sau se zyada zarre banate hain; strange zarre joron mein (pi- + p -> K0 + Lambda0).

Spin 1/2: fermions (Pauli exclusion); spin 0 ya 1: bosons (Bose-Einstein). Hadrons strong force mehsoos karte: baryons (3 quarks; p, n) aur mesons (quark + antiquark; pions). Leptons nahi: e, mu, tau aur un ke neutrinos (Table 12.3).
